# TftpdR 0.2.2

Feature release for the read-only TFTP (RFC 1350) server and the native
[Slint](https://slint.dev/) desktop panel. The panel now keeps the root directory
across launches, offers a recent-root menu, shows a local-time activity log that
can be filtered and exported, pre-warms the native folder picker, and selects the
log level from a drop-down. The title bar and toolbar are drawn as one continuous
header. Protocol, configuration format, daemon defaults and runtime behaviour are
unchanged from `0.2.1`.

**中文摘要**：0.2.2 是功能版本。面板现在会记住根目录（`last-root.txt`）、提供
最近根目录菜单；活动日志改用本地时钟，并支持级别筛选与导出；原生目录选择器改为
预热常驻 helper；日志级别改为下拉框，标题栏与工具栏合并为连续表头。协议、配置
格式、守护进程默认值与运行时行为均与 0.2.1 一致，无破坏性变更。

| Windows x86_64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.2.2-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Windows arm64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.2.2-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |

Every archive contains `tftpd-r` (headless daemon), `tftpd-r-gui` (desktop
panel), `config.example.toml`, `README.md`, `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`.
Windows archives also include `tftpd-r-gui.ico` for tools that want the icon
file. `SHA256SUMS` covers all assets in this release.

## What's new

### Root directory: honest unset state and memory across launches

- The panel starts with **no root directory** instead of a dummy `tftp-root`:
  the status bar says `未指定根目录`, the settings field is empty, and starting or
  saving reports `请先选择根目录。` until a directory is chosen.
- Without a valid `config.toml`, the root of the previous start is restored from
  `last-root.txt`. A valid `config.toml` always wins; a stale entry, a failed
  write or the override is logged instead of being dropped silently.
- The status-bar root selector opens a **recent-root menu** (at most 8 entries)
  with 选择…, which applies a directory immediately and restarts an idle server.
  Choosing a directory in the settings form only edits the form and shows
  `点击保存设置后生效` inline until 保存设置 is pressed.
- State files prefer `%APPDATA%\TftpdR` (Windows) or
  `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tftpd-r` (Unix). If that directory cannot be created or
  written, the panel falls back to `.tftpd-r` beside the executable and then to
  the working directory, logging the real location as a WARN.
- ADR: [`docs/adr/0012-gui-root-selection-and-memory.md`](https://github.com/greyskysoul/tftpd-r/blob/v0.2.2/docs/adr/0012-gui-root-selection-and-memory.md).

### Activity log with local time, exact-level filter and explicit export

- Up to 500 entries are kept in memory, newest first, stamped with the local
  wall-clock time (`HH:MM:SS`). Messages are collapsed to one line so a TOML/OS
  error cannot break the row height or the export format.
- The level filter is now a **drop-down** (`全部级别` / `仅 INFO` / `仅 WARN` /
  `仅 ERROR`) instead of four flat buttons. It remains an exact-level,
  display-only filter: retained entries and the export are never reduced, and
  clearing the filter restores every row.
- 导出 opens a native save dialog and writes the complete retained log
  oldest-first with the product version, export time, row count and a note that
  the display filter does not apply. There is no automatic log file or rotation.
- Opening a folder/save dialog is not logged; only the chosen directory, the
  export result and real failures are.
- ADR: [`docs/adr/0013-gui-activity-log.md`](https://github.com/greyskysoul/tftpd-r/blob/v0.2.2/docs/adr/0013-gui-activity-log.md)
  (including the 2026-11-22 drop-down update).

### Pre-warmed native folder picker

- On Windows, one PowerShell + WinForms helper is started in the background when
  the settings dialog or the recent-root menu opens. A click then only pays for
  the dialog itself (about 0.2 s warm versus about 1.6 s for a fresh PowerShell),
  and the helper is killed when the panel closes, including an open dialog.
- The initial directory travels over stdin and the result over stdout as UTF-8,
  so non-ASCII directory names are no longer mangled by the OEM code page. If the
  helper cannot start or dies, requests fall back to the one-shot helper.
- ADR: [`docs/adr/0014-prewarmed-folder-picker-helper.md`](https://github.com/greyskysoul/tftpd-r/blob/v0.2.2/docs/adr/0014-prewarmed-folder-picker-helper.md).

### One continuous header

- The 1 px divider between the title bar and the toolbar was removed; both rows
  share the same flat `#37474f` fill and read as one header block. The vertical
  dividers inside each row remain.
- The log-level drop-down's chevron is centred in its 30 px trigger.

## Compatibility

- No breaking changes. The TOML configuration format, `port` +
  `bind_addresses`, the read-only RRQ protocol and the default
  `127.0.0.1:69` are unchanged from `0.2.1`.
- `0.2.x` configuration files can be reused as-is. The daemon and core keep
  their own defaults; the GUI-only empty-root state is never written to
  `ServerConfig::default()` or `config.example.toml`.
- The GUI state files (`recent-dirs.txt`, `last-root.txt`, the one-time setup
  marker) are advisory: the server never reads them, and a read-only profile only
  loses the convenience of remembering them.
- Windows archives include `tftpd-r-gui.ico` and both executables keep the
  embedded seven-frame icon resource from `0.2.1`.

## Verification status

The GNU x64 build on Windows 11 with Rust 1.100.0 was verified as follows:

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D
  warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass; the suite is **177 tests**
  (1 ignored desktop-only helper test).
- `cargo build --workspace --release --locked` succeeds on the final tree in
  59.04 s. The GNU x64 sizes are 1,357,824 bytes (1.29 MiB) for `tftpd-r.exe`
  and 8,980,480 bytes (8.56 MiB) for `tftpd-r-gui.exe`.
- The drop-down was checked with `PrintWindow` captures at 1120x780 and the
  900x600 minimum window size, and with synthetic window messages: open, select
  `仅 WARN` (INFO rows hidden, filtered-empty text shown), dismiss outside
  without changing the filter, reopen and restore `全部级别`. The header capture
  shows one continuous dark band. This is not a real-mouse acceptance run.
- A Linux clippy build failure in the folder-picker worker (a Windows-only
  `std::thread` import used by the non-Windows branch) was fixed before this
  release; the Ubuntu CI job and the release test gate cover it.

The release workflow first runs the full test gate on `windows-latest` (MSVC)
and `ubuntu-latest` (GNU), then builds the four native targets. Nothing below is
verified or claimed by this release:

- running the GUI or daemon on a Linux desktop, or any `aarch64` binary
  anywhere;
- interoperability with real or legacy external TFTP clients, LAN/`0.0.0.0`
  operation, firewall rules for TID ports, and binding port 69 as an
  unprivileged user;
- RDP sessions, a real mouse/keyboard, IME input, screen readers, and rendering
  at other DPIs, locales or font stacks.

Linux binaries link the glibc of the CI runner (`ubuntu-latest`); build from
source on older distributions. The GUI needs an X11/Wayland session at runtime;
the daemon does not.

## Checksums

`SHA256SUMS` is attached to this release; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`
or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.
